_comment: Location-keyed Strong's # overrides. Key = book_id:chapter:verse:token_ordinal (get these from the token's OWN ordinal, e.g. via /api/admin/verse-tokens or the Strong's Override admin page at /admin/strongs-overrides). Unlike surface-strongs-overrides.json (keyed by bare spelling, only fills a BLANK SN, applies to every occurrence of that spelling), this REPLACES an existing SN and applies to exactly the one occurrence named by the key — so the same spelling can carry different Strong's #s in different verses. Each value is { strongs, word_raw, note }. strongs can be a real Strong's # (a correction) or a new synthetic one like "H2995a" (a homograph split — same spelling, deliberately distinct sense). See loadLexicons()/applyLocOverride*/locOverridesTargeting() in server.js for how this gets applied.
